answer: An operator holds one licensed mews and one numbered, banded falcon. Only that holder may fly the bird at local solar nadir down a surveyed vine row, stooping to official lure posts that punch the bird's telemetry anklet in order. Graders match the mews lease, band number, punch sequence, and nadir ephemeris. A shared mews, a reused band, or an off-nadir flight is forfeited as one farm. N aliases cost N licensed falcons, N exclusive mews, and N live midnight stoops no single handler can fly in the same nadir window.
